exam.exam_name: Rajasthan Joint Entrance Test (Rajasthan JET Agriculture)
exam.conducting_body: Agriculture University, Jodhpur (AUJ) on behalf of State Agriculture Universities of Rajasthan

source_evidence.captured_wording: Upload recent coloured passport size photograph (size 30 KB to 50 KB) in JPG/JPEG format with candidate name and date of snapping clearly printed on it.
source_evidence.document_title: Guidelines and Information Booklet for Joint Entrance Test (JET / Pre-PG / Ph.D.) 2024

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

spectacles.source_wording: Clear eyesight glasses allowed; tinted prohibited

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

requirements.requirement_name: Candidate Passport Photograph with Name and Date
requirements.content_instructions: JPG / JPEG; Aspect ratio 4:5; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; White or light background; Rajasthan JET strictly mandates date of photo taken after 1st January of the examination cycle
JPG / JPEG; Aspect ratio ~7:3; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm; White background; Signature in black ballpoint pen inside 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm box; capital letters rejected; Printed on JET Admit Card and Attendance Sheet

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Guidelines and Information Booklet for Joint Entrance Test (JET / Pre-PG / Ph.D.) 2024 - Section: Photo and Signature Specifications (https://jetauj2024.com)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Guidelines and Information Booklet for Joint Entrance Test (JET / Pre-PG / Ph.D.) 2024 - Section: Photo and Signature Specifications (https://jetauj2024.com)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
